name: hud_sensor_map_remove_node
description: HudSensorTracker::MapRemoveNode removes map nodes from the list, deleting the head node and unlinking non-head nodes.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly at 0x4167e0 handles head removal by updating mapNodeListHead, freeing the point array, deleting the node, and returning 1; for non-head nodes it searches the list, unlinks a matching node, and returns 1, otherwise returns 0.
Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4167e0 has no warnings or tags and shows the same head/non-head/not-found behavior.
The dependency frontier for 0x4167e0 has no visible source blockers; HudSensorMapNode::FreePointArray and operator delete are accepted.
The native hud_sensor_map_remove_and_shutdown_smoke verifies non-head unlink success and not-found failure, then exercises head removal through MapShutdownAndReset.
